sentences.en: She was right in the middle of cutting cucumbers.
Cucumbers, spinach, broccoli and onions are considered non-starchy vegetables.
sentences.zh: 黄瓜、菠菜、西兰花和洋葱都被认为是非淀粉蔬菜。
